description:
As a personal-loan borrower
  I want the yearly payment chart to reflect my loan and chosen start month
  So that I can see how much principal and interest I pay each year

elements.name: Bar chart for a loan starting Jan 2027 - 10 bars, tooltip for the Principal bar of 2028

steps.name: I launch the EMI calculator
I navigate to the "Personal Loan" tab
I use the sliders to set a loan amount of "10L", an interest rate of 12% and a tenure of 5 years
the displayed EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
I change the schedule start month to "Jan 2027" using the calendar widget
the bar chart should be visible and available
the bar chart should show the calendar years "2027,2028,2029,2030,2031"
the bar chart should contain 10 bars in total
each calendar year should have one Principal bar and one Interest bar
I hover over the "Principal" bar for 2028
the tooltip should show the year 2028
the tooltip's Principal and Total Payment values should match my amortisation schedule

elements.name: Bar chart for a loan starting Jul 2027 - 12 bars, tooltip for the Interest bar of 2027

steps.name: I launch the EMI calculator
I navigate to the "Personal Loan" tab
I use the sliders to set a loan amount of "10L", an interest rate of 12% and a tenure of 5 years
the displayed EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
I change the schedule start month to "Jul 2027" using the calendar widget
the bar chart should be visible and available
the bar chart should show the calendar years "2027,2028,2029,2030,2031,2032"
the bar chart should contain 12 bars in total
each calendar year should have one Principal bar and one Interest bar
I hover over the "Interest" bar for 2027
the tooltip should show the year 2027
the tooltip's Interest and Total Payment values should match my amortisation schedule

name: Test Case 2 - Validate the EMI bar chart (Personal Loan)

description:
As a home-loan borrower
  I want the calculator's EMI and payment break-up to be correct
  So that I can trust the figures and the pie chart it shows me

elements.name: Scenario A - EMI and pie chart for 25L at 10% over 10 years

steps.name: I launch the EMI calculator
I navigate to the "Home Loan" tab
I enter a loan amount of "25L", an interest rate of 10% and a tenure of 10 years
the displayed EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
the displayed total interest and total payment should match my calculation
the pie chart should be visible and available
the pie chart should have 2 sections: "Principal Loan Amount" and "Total Interest"
the numerical values of both pie chart sections should be greater than zero
the pie chart split should match my calculated principal and interest share

steps.name: I launch the EMI calculator
I navigate to the "Home Loan" tab
I enter a loan amount of "50L", an interest rate of 7.5% and a tenure of 15 years
the displayed EMI should match my independently calculated EMI
the displayed total interest and total payment should match my calculation
the pie chart should be visible and available
the pie chart should have 2 sections: "Principal Loan Amount" and "Total Interest"
the numerical values of both pie chart sections should be greater than zero
the pie chart split should match my calculated principal and interest share
